get.description: Browser navigation (Accept: text/html) redirects expected failures to the fixed /onboarding route with auth_error and nonsecret auth_ref (server request UUID). Codes: login_invalid, login_cancelled, login_provider_unavailable, login_rate_limited, account_unavailable, request_context_invalid. X-Auth-Error-Status preserves the original problem status; Retry-After is retained. Other clients retain problem JSON/status. Unexpected server failures remain errors.
